name: Dedan
overview: Dedan is a male biblical figure known primarily as the son of Jokshan, as recorded in Genesis 25:3. There is no tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about him, making his identity closely tied to his paternal lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Dedan appears as a proper name in Scripture without an explicit meaning or divine origin noted. It is simply presented as the personal name of this individual in Genesis 25:3.
familyAndRelationships: Dedan is identified as the son of Jokshan. Jokshan himself is a descendant of Asshur, Letush, and Leum, indicating Dedan's place within this genealogical line. Scripture does not provide further family details beyond these relationships.
scriptureSignificance: Dedan's significance lies in his position within the genealogical record of Genesis, marking him as a descendant of Abraham through Jokshan. This lineage contributes to the biblical understanding of nations and peoples originating from Abraham's family, underscoring God's providential plan through His covenant people.
